message: sts:AssumeRole in boundary allows privilege escalation — partner can assume other roles and escape boundary constraints
Boundary grants s3:GetObject and s3:ListBucket on Resource: * — created role can read any S3 bucket in the account

Boundary Allow statement 'unnamed' grants cross-account-capable actions (s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket, sts:AssumeRole) without aws:ResourceAccount condition. The created role could access resources in other accounts if cross-account resource policies permit it. Add "StringEquals": {"aws:ResourceAccount": "${aws:PrincipalAccount}"} to restrict to same-account.

The resource ARN account ID partner is not valid. Provide a 12-digit account ID. [INVALID_ARN_ACCOUNT] See: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/IAM/latest/UserGuide/access-analyzer-reference-policy-checks.html#access-analyzer-reference-policy-checks-error-invalid-arn-account
